title: AMC 10 Practice: Geometric Sequence Triangles — Is It Really 44?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on triangles whose integer sides form a geometric sequence, solved with a ratio and the triangle inequality. (Level 5 of 5)
A triangle's three whole-number sides grow by the same multiplier, and the longest side is 2025. How many such triangles are there? Vantee writes the ratio over 45, lets the triangle rule trim the list, then shows a faster middle-side trick and gives you a smaller one to try.
